citations.claim: controlled body exactly at waypoint 2 position before failure, distance to target ~0
speed essentially zero at waypoint, controller about to compute new direction
energy also becomes non-finite at same step

counterfactual.change: Moved waypoint 2 x by +0.5 (7.135->7.635) so controlled body never has zero distance to target at arrival; all other fields identical, steps unchanged. This avoids 0/0 normalization and violation disappears.

explanation: Controller reaches waypoint exactly at step 1227, distance to target becomes zero. Controller's direction/velocity command likely normalizes displacement by that distance ( (waypoint-pos)/dist * vcmd ), causing 0/0 -> NaN which propagates to force, work, velocity and position at step 1228, triggering non-finite position/velocity and energy.
vision_note: Steps 1225-1227 show the red body stable at the top and blue bodies resting near the floor and platforms with a waypoint at the far top-right. At step 1228 the red body abruptly vanishes (no longer rendered) and the remaining bodies overlap each other, while a waypoint cross jumps to mid-air and the following frames turn black as the simulation stops.
